content.text: Stripe's availability map covers 46 countries. PayPal's risk engine flags accounts from Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and dozens of other markets before any human review occurs. Gumroad holds payouts for up to 30 days in certain regions. Lemon Squeezy and Paddle are unavailable across most of Africa, South Asia, and Latin America. These are not temporary oversights waiting to be corrected — they are deliberate structural decisions built into conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-broken-here-infrastructure-2|payment]] infrastructure designed for Western banking systems. The solution is not finding a workaround inside this system. It is building on infrastructure that does not have the [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/problem-venezuelan-creators-accepting-crypto-payments-how-solve-2|The Problem]] in the first place. That means GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain payment verification. No platform can restrict access to a store that runs under your own accounts with no dependency on any payment processor.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Ebooks online

When [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-plugins-without-payment-processor-14|COREMERCH guide to comparing]] options for selling ebooks without PayPal, it's crucial to understand what each platform offers. Stripe, though widely used, is not available in many countries, while PayPal has its own set of restrictions and can suspend accounts, holding funds for up to 180 days. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure, like the Edge Commerce Stack, provides a comprehensive solution with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Gumroad's payout delays, Payhip's withdrawal restrictions, and Lemon Squeezy's geographic unavailability all stem from the same root cause: these platforms operate within the traditional financial system. They process payments through Stripe or PayPal on the backend, which means they inherit every restriction those processors impose. When Stripe does not support your country, Gumroad cannot pay you out — regardless of what the platform's feature list implies. Paddle operates as a merchant of record, which creates additional compliance requirements that make it functionally unavailable in most of Africa, South Asia, and Latin America. These are not platform-level problems. They are financial system problems that only infrastructure built outside that system can solve.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

NOWPayments operates as a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT on multiple chains, Solana, BNB on Binance Smart Chain, and Tron. When a buyer initiates payment, NOWPayments creates a unique payment address for that specific transaction, monitors the blockchain in real time, and fires a webhook when payment confirms on-chain. The 0.5% fee is the only cost — no monthly fee, no setup fee, no revenue share, no payout schedule. Funds go directly to the wallet addresses you configure. COREMERCH never touches your wallet or your funds at any point before, during, or after deployment.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure provides a permanent structural alternative to traditional payment platforms.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

The asymmetric risk of platform dependency becomes concrete only when the platform acts. While a PayPal or Stripe account is functioning normally, the risk feels theoretical and distant. When it stops functioning — through suspension, policy change, or geographic restriction enforcement — the creator loses their revenue channel instantly, often with funds already inside the platform that cannot be withdrawn. The conventional appeals process rarely reverses these decisions because the original decision was made algorithmically and the human review process operates on the platform's timeline and criteria, not yours. Sovereign infrastructure eliminates this asymmetry entirely. Your Cloudflare Pages storefront cannot be suspended by a payment processor's compliance decision. Your wallet cannot be frozen by anyone.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

For digital creators in restricted countries, sovereign commerce infrastructure offers a permanent structural alternative to traditional payment platforms. By choosing a solution like the Edge Commerce Stack, creators can ensure they have a reliable and efficient way to sell their digital products, without the risk of account suspensions or geographical restrictions. This infrastructure-confident approach enables creators to focus on their craft, rather than worrying about payment processing

This involves deploying a customizable stack that includes automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. With solutions like the Edge Commerce Stack, you can bypass traditional payment gateways and sell your ebooks and digital products online, regardless of your geographical location.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your own sovereign commerce infrastructure, start by selecting a hosting platform like Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Next, choose a backend logic solution like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and integrate it with a storage solution like Supabase or Google Sheets. Then, configure your payment processing with NOWPayments, and set up your product delivery system using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, test your setup end-to-end to ensure a seamless sales experience for your customers.
